title: Railway service loses its state file on every redeploy despite STATE_DIR=/data
symptoms: History and state are empty after each deploy
cause: Setting an environment variable to /data does not create storage. Without a volume mounted there, the container filesystem is discarded on each deploy.
fix: Create a volume mounted at that path and confirm the mount in the deploy log.
apply: railway service <name> && railway volume add --mount-path /data; then check the deploy log for 'Mounting volume on:' before 'Starting Container'
